words.example: The cubicle beside the window is set aside for staff counseling.
words.exampleZh: 靠窗的那间隔间留给员工约谈用。

words.example: The workstation area is too noisy for a private phone call.
words.exampleZh: 工位区太吵，不适合打需要保密的电话。

words.example: Please use the quiet room when a family needs a private talk.
words.exampleZh: 家属需要私下谈话时，请使用安静室。

words.example: The on-call room is at the far end of the east corridor.
words.exampleZh: 值班室在东走廊的最尽头。

words.example: The night clerk rests in the duty room between phone calls.
words.exampleZh: 夜班文员在两次来电之间，在值班房里休息。

words.example: Set affinity so the database VM stays on the same host as its log VM.
words.exampleZh: 设好亲和性，让数据库虚拟机和它的日志虚拟机留在同一台主机。

words.example: Anti-affinity keeps the two domain controllers on different hosts.
words.exampleZh: 反亲和性让两台域控制器跑在不同的主机上。

words.example: The resource pool for lab VMs is capped so they cannot starve the HIS host.
words.exampleZh: 实验室虚拟机的资源池加了上限，免得把 HIS 那台主机的资源吃光。

words.example: Set a memory reservation on the HIS VM so ballooning cannot reclaim it.
words.exampleZh: 给 HIS 虚拟机设内存资源预留，内存回收就收不走这部分。

words.example: The CPU limit on the lab VM is why that test build runs so slowly.
words.exampleZh: 实验室虚拟机的处理器资源上限，就是那个测试构建这么慢的原因。
